transcript: Mard, 45 saal. Ek hafte se khansi. Pala balgham ho raha. Ghabrahat baad ho raha. Saans phoolna seene pet dard hai. Ghabrahat baad aadhi nahi hai. Augmentin 625 din mein do baar, 5 din. Khansi raat zaroorat chamach din mein teen baar. Seret band karni hai. Cbc test karwa lein.

advice: Take cough syrup with food three times daily at night
